issues.title: Broken External Symbol Resolution
issues.why: AC-SC-22 mandates resolving 'apperror' and 'AB-NNNN' codes via spec/03, but the provided context only contains spec/06. A mediocre AI cannot verify the constructor signatures or registry existence.
issues.fix: Provide the normative content of spec/03-error-manage/02-error-architecture/06-apperror-package/ in the context.

issues.title: Conflicting Type Enums in Sub-features
issues.why: 02-features/01-rag-chunk-settings.md still uses forbidden legacy types (int, float) in its tables and SQL snippets, contradicting the PascalCase/UI-aware enum pin in 00-overview and AC-SC-14.
issues.fix: Update all tables in 02-features/01-rag-chunk-settings.md to use 'number' and 'boolean' instead of 'int', 'float', or 'bool'.

issues.title: Ambiguous Rollback File State
issues.why: AC-SC-07 describes rolling back the DB via CHANGELOG replay but does not explicitly state if the physical config.seed.json file should be reverted or if the system should just ignore it.
issues.fix: Clarify in AC-SC-07 that rollback only affects DB state and Metadata, while the seed file remains as-is on disk.
